about: Every story in the newsroom: something that happened, dated, with the page that carries it. The newsroom carries PFA's cases and CineKind; policy and law are not newsroom stories and live on the achievements and laws pages (owner, 5 Oct 2026). Order does not matter. front (1 to 4) places a story on the front page; with none marked, the four newest go there. Edit this file, then run node scripts/build-newsroom.js (DEPLOY.command runs it for you). HANDBOOK.md section 11.

stories.title: CineKind 2026: eleven honours presented in Mumbai
stories.dek: The second CineKind Awards were presented by the Film Federation of India with People for Animals at The Leela, Mumbai, on World Animal Day: eleven honours, from Anant Ambani to Rajan Shahi, for work that leaves the frame kinder.

stories.title: CineKind’s second edition announced in Mumbai
stories.dek: Maneka Gandhi, with the Film Federation of India's Abhay Sinha and Sandeep Marwah, announced the 2026 honours and called on cinema to become a voice for animals, since what audiences watch on screen shapes how they treat them.

stories.title: Removed for a VIP visit. Returned by a city.
stories.dek: PEC had 35 community dogs picked up before the Prime Minister’s visit, then declined their return. Four offices, one protest, six states: the director cleared every single one.

image.alt: The protest at the gates: rows of people on the campus steps holding placards for the dogs

stories.title: 52,401 wild animals rescued, treated and released in Bengaluru
stories.dek: PFA’s wildlife hospital in Bengaluru has cared for 29,144 birds, 15,212 reptiles and 8,034 mammals. Among them, a cobra badly hurt by a construction vehicle was treated for nearly 11 months, learned to hunt again and went back to the wild.

stories.title: A high-welfare pig housing model opens in Rishikesh
stories.dek: Built by the People for Animals Public Policy Foundation with Uttarakhand’s Animal Husbandry Department at Pashulok, the unit shows group housing and cage-free farrowing with room to nest, so that pigs can move freely and live healthier, calmer lives.

stories.title: Four young donkeys rescued from a Dehradun building site
stories.dek: PFA Uttarakhand found four young donkeys weak, dehydrated and hurt from carrying building material up ten floors. Police registered an FIR, and the donkeys now live at PFA’s Happy Home Sanctuary in Chharba, where a court has ordered they stay.

stories.title: A protected Indian roofed turtle saved from sale in Chandigarh
stories.dek: On a People for Animals complaint, police and the Forest and Wildlife Department stopped the sale of an Indian roofed turtle, a Schedule I species, registered an FIR under the Wildlife (Protection) Act and placed the turtle in the Department’s care.

stories.title: Birds hurt by kite string, flying again within days
stories.dek: Over Sankranti, PFA’s wildlife hospital in Bengaluru treated birds cut by manja. A feather bank covering 32 species lets its vets replace damaged flight feathers, so a bird that once needed months to recover can fly again in days.

stories.title: Ten honours at CineKind’s first edition
stories.dek: Presented by the Film Federation of India with People for Animals, in Kolkata on 20 December 2025.

image.alt: Nitin Vemupati, honoured with S. A. Chandrasekhar for Kooran

stories.title: Over 400 animals saved from the Gadhimai sacrifice given lifelong homes
stories.dek: With the Sashastra Seema Bal and the Bihar government, PFA and Humane Society International/India stopped animals being taken across the border for the festival. 347 goats and 74 buffaloes were rehomed, including at PFA Uttarakhand’s Happy Home Sanctuary.
